# Poof

Empowering millions of digital businesses & creators with payments from crypto to fiat

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/poof/.

## Actions

- **Check Balance** (read-only): Check the balance of a cryptocurrency wallet.
- **Create Checkout Session**: Create a checkout session for fiat payments.
- **Create Deposit Address**: Create a deposit address for receiving cryptocurrency payments.
- **Create Fiat Charge**: Create a fiat currency charge through Poof's payment gateway integration.
- **Create Fiat Invoice**: Create a fiat currency invoice for payment collection.
- **Create Payment Link**: Create a payment link (invoice) for cryptocurrency payments.
- **Send Cryptocurrency Payout**: Send a cryptocurrency payout transaction from your wallet to an external address.
- **Create Poof Webhook**: Create a webhook subscription for receiving payment event notifications.
- **Fetch Cryptocurrency Price** (read-only): Fetch current cryptocurrency prices for supported tokens.
- **Fetch Gas Price** (read-only): Fetch current gas prices for blockchain transactions.
- **Fetch Smart Contracts** (read-only): Fetch all supported ERC-20 smart contracts across Ethereum, Avalanche, and Polygon networks.
